import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long capacity;
        int cost;
        int rev;

        public Edge(int to, long capacity, int cost, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class CostFlow {
        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        long[] dist;
        int[] parent;
        int[] parentEdge;
        long totalCost;

        public CostFlow(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            dist = new long[n];
            parent = new int[n];
            parentEdge = new int[n];
            totalCost = 0;
        }

        public void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, int cst) {
            adj.get(u).add(new Edge(v, cap, cst, adj.get(v).size()));
            adj.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, -cst, adj.get(u).size() - 1));
        }

        public long computeMinCostFlow(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE >> 5;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                dist[s] = 0;
                Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.offer(s);
                boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[n];
                inQueue[s] = true;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = q.poll();
                    inQueue[u] = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                        if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost < dist[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                            parent[e.to] = u;
                            parentEdge[e.to] = i;
                            if (!inQueue[e.to]) {
                                q.offer(e.to);
                                inQueue[e.to] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == Long.MAX_VALUE) break;
                long pushFlow = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    int u = parent[v];
                    pushFlow = Math.min(pushFlow, adj.get(u).get(parentEdge[v]).capacity);
                }
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    int u = parent[v];
                    Edge e = adj.get(u).get(parentEdge[v]);
                    e.capacity -= pushFlow;
                    Edge revEdge = adj.get(v).get(e.rev);
                    revEdge.capacity += pushFlow;
                    totalCost += pushFlow * e.cost;
                }
                flow += pushFlow;
            }
            return totalCost;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int kk = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int[] a = new int[kk + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= kk; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        int s = 0;
        int t = n * 100 + 1;
        CostFlow flow = new CostFlow(n * 100 + 2);
        final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE >> 5;

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
            flow.addEdge(i, t, INF, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= kk; i++) {
            flow.addEdge(s, (a[i] - 1) * 100 + 1, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                flow.addEdge((i - 1) * 100 + j, (i - 1) * 100 + j + 1, INF, c);
            }
        }
        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            int t1 = sc.nextInt();
            int t2 = sc.nextInt();
            for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= kk; j++) {
                    int val = c + d * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1));
                    flow.addEdge((t1 - 1) * 100 + i, (t2 - 1) * 100 + i + 1, 1, val);
                    flow.addEdge((t2 - 1) * 100 + i, (t1 - 1) * 100 + i + 1, 1, val);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(flow.computeMinCostFlow(s, t));
        sc.close();
    }
}
